tests.full_name: journal and rollback > restores changelogs (absent and rewritten) when a later step fails with changelog generation on

gaps.missing: No apply-release-plan test enables changelog generation. Rollback of a CHANGELOG.md that did not exist before the run (restored to absence), and of an existing CHANGELOG.md that was rewritten, is never exercised.
gaps.reproduction: In packages/apply-release-plan, use a real changelog generator (changelog not false). Start with pkg-a having no CHANGELOG.md and pkg-b with one. Make a later step fail (the changeset rm, or the pkg-b CHANGELOG write). Assert the tree snapshot equals the pre-run one: pkg-a/CHANGELOG.md absent, pkg-b/CHANGELOG.md in its previous bytes, and err.cause is the original error.

clauses.trace: With a real changelog generator, pkg-a has no CHANGELOG.md and pkg-b has one; after the changeset rm fails, the tree snapshot equals the pre-run one (L164) and pkg-a/CHANGELOG.md is absent (L165).
The rejection's cause is the injected original error (L163).

gaps.explanation: The exact reproduction (real changelog generator, absent and existing CHANGELOG.md, later changeset rm failure) passes on the unchanged base, so the gap does not reproduce; rollback already covers CHANGELOG.md candidates.
